# META-INSIGHTS — about the optimization PROCESS itself (this run)

Not about the capability — about HOW this run is searching for it: which strategies/edit classes/algorithms are helping vs stalling, and what to try next iteration. Update at the end of the run at minimum; sooner if a plateau or a clear strategy shift is worth recording now. Structure each addition as:

    ## Iteration <id> (or 'run so far')
    - Strategy tried, and whether it moved val (cite LEDGER rows):
    - Plateau/stall signal, if any, and the lever switched to:
    - What to try next iteration:

## Iteration cand_0001 (first, empty seed)
- Strategy tried: diagnose ALL clusters from trajectories first, then ship a multi-class candidate in one pass (code guards + a new loop tool + enriched errors + additive prompt rules), preferring deterministic code over prose per the tools SKILL. Val effect unknown yet (harness stamps RESULT after stop; LEDGER empty going in).
- Diagnosis leverage: a small reusable trace-extractor (gold from metadata.tau2_reward_info.action_checks, agent calls from raw_data.choices) made per-task root-causing cheap enough to skip subagent fan-out. Verifying each fix by running the actual tool body on the exact trace args (in venv-skillberry-tau2) caught a real bug — payment_history stayed stale after the guard corrected the amounts list — that static reading would have missed. KEY META-LESSON: always execute the guard, don't just read it.
- Plateau/stall signal: n/a (first iteration).
- What to try next iteration: read the RESULT line before designing. If a bounded guard broke a passing task, the bound was wrong — narrow the fire condition, don't drop the fix. If list_reservations didn't move 17/22, the failure is the MATCH step not the LOOKUP — try returning a ranked best-match hint. For any still-open narrated-without-action task, escalate from prose (this iteration) to a composite confirm-then-execute WRITE tool (SKILL lever 2). Keep candidates multi-class but keep every guard bounded.
